name: Sanctions & coercion
value: US Iran listings 5–6 Nov; EU 1,569 on 12 Oct
summary: US adds Iran-linked shipping, aviation and digital-asset targets on 5–6 Nov; no major economy cut off
state: The US Treasury sanctioned an India-based network and a Türkiye-based airline services firm over Iranian oil and aviation on 5 Nov (ANI via Republic World), and the State Department announced listings of eight digital-asset providers on 6 Nov, coordinated with Canada. The EU added 1,569 Russia-related listings on 12 Oct (GvW). Searches on 8 Nov found no major economy cut off from payment systems.
for_you: Firms in shipping, aviation, crypto and trade finance with links to Iran or Russia carry the most exposure. New listings tend to bring tighter compliance checks and delays for banks and counterparties well beyond the named targets.
rubric_hit: Watch: major new packages, including US Iran designations on 5–6 Nov and 1,569 EU listings on 12 Oct. Alert line (major economy cut off from payment systems) not met.
